basic_details.short_information: Airports Authority of India (AAI), Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Notification has been released on 28-07-2026 on the official website. A total of 140 Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Apprentice vacancies have been announced through the AAI Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27.

important_dates.raw: The notification does not specify the application start date or last date. Candidates are advised to check the respective apprenticeship portals (NATS/NAPS) regularly for updates on the application window. | Notification Date: 28-07-2026 Application Last Date: To be announced soon

qualification.details: Nationality: Indian Nationals only Domicile: Candidates must belong to West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Sikkim, or Andaman & Nicobar (Eastern Region states) Qualification: Must have passed the relevant degree, diploma, or ITI course in or after 2024, as assessed on 30/06/2026 Age Limit: Not specified in the notification

vacancy_details.Stipend: ₹9,600/- per month (1st year), ₹10,560/- per month (2nd year)

category_wise_breakdown.stipend: ₹9,600/- per month (1st year), ₹10,560/- per month (2nd year)

category_wise_vacancy.Stipend: ₹9,600/- per month (1st year), ₹10,560/- per month (2nd year)

salary_details.details: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend based on their category. Graduate apprentices will receive ₹15,000 per month, Diploma apprentices ₹12,000 per month, and ITI apprentices ₹9,600 per month during the first year of training and ₹10,560 per month during the second year, applicable to National or State Trade Certificate holders whose prior training period is accounted for in determining the stipend rate.

how_to_apply: Graduate and Diploma candidates should visit the NATS portal at nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates should visit the NAPS portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Register on the respective portal and search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to the desired location (see Enrolment ID table below)
Fill in the required details and submit the online application
Applications submitted through any other mode will not be accepted
important_instructions: During the apprenticeship period, candidates will be governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended in 1973 and till date) and the commensurate policies/rules of the organization AAI reserves the right to increase, decrease, or cancel the apprenticeship engagement process without assigning any reason Applications submitted through any mode other than the official NATS/NAPS portals will not be accepted

Candidates who have completed their graduation or diploma can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Diploma Government Jobs available across India. ITI-qualified candidates can check the latest ITI Apprentice Jobs and Apprenticeship Jobs 2026 in various sectors. Those looking for opportunities in the Eastern Region can also browse West Bengal Government Jobs, Odisha Government Jobs, Bihar Government Jobs, and Jharkhand Government Jobs for more openings in their state.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AAI Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A total of 140 vacancies are available: 35 Graduate, 35 Diploma, and 70 ITI apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AAI Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for AAI apprentices?
faq.answer: Graduate apprentices receive ₹15,000/month, Diploma apprentices receive ₹12,000/month, and ITI apprentices receive ₹9,600/month (1st year) and ₹10,560/month (2nd year).

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for AAI Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Indian Nationals domiciled in West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Sikkim, and Andaman & Nicobar are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for AAI apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed their degree, diploma, or ITI course in or after 2024, as assessed on 30/06/2026.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for AAI Eastern Region Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Graduate and Diploma candidates must apply via the NATS portal, and ITI candidates via the NAPS portal, using the AAI Establishment ID for their preferred location.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the AAI apprenticeship program?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship program is for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q8. At which locations are AAI apprentice vacancies available?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available at RHQ ER Kolkata and at Bagdogra, Gaya, Patna, Birsa Munda (Ranchi), Raipur, Bhubaneswar, Pakyong, Jharsuguda, and VSI (Sri Vijaya Puram) airports.
